---
# ── POST TEMPLATE — copy into src/content/posts/<slug>.mdx ──
# (filename becomes the URL: my-post.mdx → /writing/my-post/)
# REQUIRED:
title: Post title
description: One sentence shown on the writing index, cards, and meta tags.
date: 2026-01-01
draft: true # visible in local dev, excluded from the live site.

# OPTIONAL:
featured: false # true = appears in the homepage Featured section
tags: [] # free-form, e.g. [qmk, astro, build-log]
# cover: ../../assets/some-folder/photo.jpeg   # card/share image
# project: 36ribs # slug of a related project — the post links to it and appears in that project's "Build logs & posts" list
---

Body is markdown (MDX). Start headings at ## — the frontmatter title is the page's h1. Code blocks get syntax highlighting:

```ts
const hello = 'world';
```

Images: put files in `src/assets/your-folder/` and reference relatively —
and an *italic line* directly under an image renders as its caption:
`![alt text](../../assets/some-folder/photo.jpeg)`

Interactive compare slider (import at the top of the frontmatter-adjacent body):
`import ImageCompare from '../../components/ImageCompare.astro';`
`<ImageCompare left={imgA} right={imgB} leftAlt="..." rightAlt="..." caption="Description of the comparison." />`
Optional props: `leftLabel`, `rightLabel` for corner text. Images should share an aspect ratio.
